name: dinosaurs
inputText:
Tyrannosaurus Rex — the largest land predator, 40 feet long, tiny arms, bone-crushing bite
Triceratops — three-horned dinosaur with a massive shield-like frill, plant eater
Stegosaurus — plates along its back and a spiked tail called a thagomizer, small brain
Velociraptor — fast pack hunter, about the size of a turkey, feathered, sharp curved claws
Brachiosaurus — towering long-necked herbivore, 85 feet long, could reach treetops
Pteranodon — giant flying reptile with 20-foot wingspan, not actually a dinosaur

rooms.name: Thunder Jaw Crater
rooms.itemToRemember: Tyrannosaurus Rex — largest land predator, 40 feet long, tiny arms, bone-crushing bite
rooms.mnemonic: A T-Rex stomps into a volcanic crater and tries to clap its ridiculously tiny arms — but its jaws crush a boulder instead, sending shockwaves across the ground.
rooms.sceneDescription: A massive Tyrannosaurus Rex stands in the center of a volcanic crater at dusk, mouth open in a roar, revealing rows of enormous teeth. Its tiny arms hang comically small against its 40-foot body. Molten lava glows orange through cracks in the dark basalt floor around its feet. The sky is a dramatic gradient of deep purple and fiery orange. Steam rises around the dinosaur. The T-Rex is photorealistic, detailed scales and texture, lit dramatically from below by the lava glow. Cinematic composition, wide-angle.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: A massive Tyrannosaurus Rex stands in a volcanic crater at dusk, mouth open in a roar. Tiny arms visible against its huge body. Molten lava glows through cracks in dark basalt around its feet. Purple and orange sky. Steam rises. Photorealistic, cinematic, wide-angle lens.

The T-Rex slams its massive foot down, cracking the basalt floor. Lava splashes upward from the cracks. The ground shakes. Its tiny arms twitch uselessly at its sides while its enormous head swings toward the camera.

The T-Rex lunges forward and its massive jaws slam shut on a boulder with a thunderous crack, shattering it into pieces. Dust and sparks explode outward. Fragments of rock fly through the air. The shockwave ripples across the crater floor.

rooms.name: Crystal Horn Fortress
rooms.itemToRemember: Triceratops — three-horned dinosaur with a massive shield-like frill, plant eater
rooms.mnemonic: Three glowing crystal horns guard a fortress gate shaped like a giant frill — but instead of attacking, the Triceratops munches flowers growing from the castle walls.
rooms.sceneDescription: A large Triceratops stands proudly in a lush meadow, facing the camera. Its three sharp horns are prominent — two long brow horns and one shorter nose horn. Its massive bony frill spreads wide like a shield behind its head, decorated with patterns. The Triceratops is peacefully eating from a bush of colorful tropical flowers. Warm golden afternoon light. Behind it, an ancient overgrown stone wall covered in flowering vines. The dinosaur's skin is textured with bumpy scales in earthy greens and browns. Photorealistic, detailed, cinematic wide-angle.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: A large Triceratops stands in a lush meadow facing the camera. Three sharp horns prominent, massive bony frill spread wide like a shield. Eating colorful flowers from a bush. Golden afternoon light. Ancient overgrown stone wall behind. Photorealistic, cinematic, wide-angle.

The Triceratops lifts its massive head from the flowers, chewing slowly. Flower petals fall from its mouth. Its three horns catch the golden sunlight and gleam. The frill tilts upward, revealing intricate scale patterns. It stamps one front foot.

The Triceratops lowers its head and charges forward playfully, three horns pointed ahead. Flowers and grass fly up from its thundering feet. The ground shakes. Its massive frill acts like a battering ram as it smashes through a section of the vine-covered wall, scattering stone and petals everywhere.

rooms.name: Solar Plate Ridge
rooms.itemToRemember: Stegosaurus — plates along its back and a spiked tail called a thagomizer, small brain
rooms.mnemonic: A row of golden dinner plates lines a mountain ridge like solar panels, and at the end, four enormous spikes swing like a medieval mace — the famous 'thagomizer' named after a cartoon caveman.
rooms.sceneDescription: A Stegosaurus walks along a mountain ridge at sunrise, seen from the side. The row of large diamond-shaped bony plates along its back are catching the first golden rays of sunlight, glowing like solar panels. Its spiked tail — four sharp spikes at the tip, the famous thagomizer — is raised and visible. The dinosaur has a small head relative to its large body. Below in the valley, soft morning mist. The rocky terrain has ferns and prehistoric plants. Everything bathed in warm golden-hour light. The Stegosaurus is photorealistic with textured gray-green scales. Cinematic, dramatic composition.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: A Stegosaurus walks along a mountain ridge at sunrise, seen from the side. Diamond-shaped plates along its back glow golden in sunlight. Four-spiked thagomizer tail raised. Small head, large body. Morning mist in valley below. Photorealistic, cinematic, wide-angle.

The sun rises higher and each plate along the Stegosaurus's back catches the light in sequence, glowing intensely from front to back. The plates seem to pulse with solar energy. The dinosaur turns its tiny head slowly, looking around with a dull expression.

The Stegosaurus swings its spiked tail in a powerful arc, the four thagomizer spikes whooshing through ferns and shattering a small rock formation with tremendous force. Debris and fern fronds fly outward. The spikes gleam dangerously in the morning sun.

rooms.name: Feather Sprint Hollow
rooms.itemToRemember: Velociraptor — fast pack hunter, about the size of a turkey, feathered, sharp curved claws
rooms.mnemonic: A pack of turkey-sized feathered raptors doing parkour through a jungle — each one flashing a single deadly curved claw like a switchblade as they leap between branches.
rooms.sceneDescription: Three Velociraptors perched on jungle branches at different heights, alert and watching. They are turkey-sized with colorful iridescent feathers — blue, green, and copper plumage. Each one has a prominent curved sickle claw on its hind foot, raised and visible. Dense prehistoric jungle with shafts of green-filtered light cutting through the canopy. Deep claw marks score the tree trunks. The raptors look intelligent and dangerous despite their small size. Photorealistic feather detail, cinematic lighting through the jungle canopy, wide-angle composition.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: Three turkey-sized Velociraptors perched on jungle branches at different heights. Iridescent blue-green feathers, curved sickle claws raised on hind feet. Dense prehistoric jungle, green-filtered light through canopy. Claw marks on trees. Photorealistic, cinematic, wide-angle.

The Velociraptors leap into action simultaneously, darting between branches with incredible speed. Iridescent feathers flash blue and green in the light. Leaves and small branches shake violently. Their movements are coordinated like a pack hunting together.

One Velociraptor lands on a branch directly in front of the camera, its curved sickle claw extended and gleaming like a switchblade. It tilts its feathered head, intelligent eyes locked on the viewer. Two more appear on either side, surrounding the camera. Feathers ruffle in the breeze.

rooms.name: Cloud Canopy Tower
rooms.itemToRemember: Brachiosaurus — towering long-necked herbivore, 85 feet long, could reach treetops
rooms.mnemonic: A living skyscraper with a giraffe-pattern neck stretches up through the clouds to munch on a floating garden — 85 feet of pure gentle giant.
rooms.sceneDescription: An enormous Brachiosaurus towers over a prehistoric forest, its incredibly long neck reaching up into golden clouds above the treetops. The dinosaur is seen from below at ground level, emphasizing its staggering 85-foot height. Four pillar-like legs as thick as tree trunks support its massive body. Its skin is warm terracotta with darker giraffe-like patches. Tiny colorful birds perch along its neck. Its small head is partially hidden in the clouds, munching on high branches. Warm dappled sunlight filters through the forest. The scale is awe-inspiring — it dwarfs everything. Photorealistic, ultra-wide-angle, looking up.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: An enormous Brachiosaurus towers over a prehistoric forest, seen from below. Incredibly long neck reaching into golden clouds above treetops. Pillar-like legs, terracotta skin with giraffe patches. Birds on neck. Head munching branches in clouds. Photorealistic, ultra-wide-angle, looking up.

The Brachiosaurus's enormous head slowly descends through the cloud layer, bringing a cascade of leaves and flower petals. Its gentle face emerges — wide flat teeth visible as it chews peacefully. Clouds swirl around its head like a halo. Birds flutter nearby.

The Brachiosaurus takes a slow earth-shaking step forward. The ground trembles. Ferns flatten under its enormous foot. Birds scatter from its neck in a colorful burst. Treetops sway as its massive body moves between them. Dust rises from the forest floor.

rooms.name: Wingspan Cliff
rooms.itemToRemember: Pteranodon — giant flying reptile with 20-foot wingspan, not actually a dinosaur
rooms.mnemonic: A hang-glider the size of a small airplane soars over ocean cliffs with a sign around its neck: 'NOT A DINOSAUR' — because Pteranodon was a flying reptile, not a true dinosaur.
rooms.sceneDescription: A giant Pteranodon soars over a dramatic ocean cliff at golden hour, wings fully spread showing its incredible 20-foot wingspan. The flying reptile is seen from slightly below, its distinctive pointed head crest and long beak silhouetted against a spectacular sunset of orange, pink, and purple clouds. Its leathery wings are stretched taut, membranes visible against the light. Below, turquoise waves crash against jagged rocks. Seabirds scatter around it, looking tiny by comparison. Windswept grass and wildflowers on the cliff edge in the foreground. Photorealistic, cinematic, dramatic composition.

odysseyKeyframes.prompt: A giant Pteranodon soars over ocean cliffs at golden hour, wings fully spread showing 20-foot wingspan. Pointed head crest and long beak against spectacular sunset. Leathery wing membranes visible. Turquoise waves below. Seabirds scatter. Photorealistic, cinematic, wide-angle.

The Pteranodon banks sharply, tilting its enormous wings. Its shadow sweeps across the ocean surface and up the cliff face. The wingspan stretches impossibly wide against the sunset. Wind ripples across the water below.

The Pteranodon swoops low directly overhead, its leathery wings stretched wide, wingtips nearly touching the cliff edges. Wind from its wings ripples through the grass and wildflowers. Its crested head turns, one eye visible, beak open. The sunset blazes behind it.
